import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPSULE = ROOM;

    static int[][] station = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] capsuleAt = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] poison = new int[61][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static class Pos {
        int x, y, qnt;
        Pos(int _x, int _y, int _q) {
            x = _x; y = _y; qnt = _q;
        }
    }

    static List<Pos> person = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Pos> capsule = new ArrayList<>();

    static boolean inside(int x, int y, int n) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n && station[x][y] == ROOM;
    }

    static int cellType(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (c == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (c == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
        return -1;
    }

    static int cellNumber(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static void spread_venom(int x, int y, int T, int n) {
        poison[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (poison[t - 1][i][j] == 1) {
                        poison[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                            if (inside(ni, nj, n)) poison[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int travel_time(Pos a, Pos b, int n, int T) {
        boolean[][] seen = new boolean[n][n];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, a.x, a.y});
        seen[a.x][a.y] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int t = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1], y = cur[2];

            if (x == b.x && y == b.y) return t;
            if (t == T) continue;
            if (poison[t][x][y] == 1) continue;

            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (inside(nx, ny, n) && !seen[nx][ny] && poison[t][nx][ny] == 0) {
                    seen[nx][ny] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{t + 1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, flow, cap;
        int rest() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        int[] parent, parentEdge;

        FlowNetwork(int _n) {
            n = _n;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            parent = new int[n];
            parentEdge = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
            Edge a = new Edge();
            a.to = v;
            a.rev = adj.get(v).size();
            a.flow = 0;
            a.cap = c;
            Edge b = new Edge();
            b.to = u;
            b.rev = adj.get(u).size();
            b.flow = 0;
            b.cap = 0;
            adj.get(u).add(a);
            adj.get(v).add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Arrays.fill(parentEdge, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            parent[s] = s;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); ++i) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                    if (e.rest() > 0 && parent[e.to] == -1) {
                        parent[e.to] = u;
                        parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                        if (e.to == t) return true;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int augment(int s, int t) {
            int pushed = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                pushed = Math.min(pushed, adj.get(parent[v]).get(parentEdge[v]).rest());
            }
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                Edge e = adj.get(parent[v]).get(parentEdge[v]);
                e.flow += pushed;
                adj.get(v).get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) total += augment(s, t);
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        Pos bad = new Pos(0, 0, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = cellType(ch);
                int value = cellNumber(ch);

                station[i][j] = type;
                if (type == ROOM && value > 0) person.add(new Pos(i, j, value));
                if (type == BAD_REAC) bad = new Pos(i, j, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = cellType(ch);
                int value = cellNumber(ch);

                if (type == CAPSULE && value > 0) {
                    capsule.add(new Pos(i, j, value));
                    capsuleAt[i][j] = value;
                }
            }
        }

        FlowNetwork flow = new FlowNetwork(MAXN);
        int S = 0, SNK = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < person.size(); ++i)
            flow.addEdge(S, i * 2 + 1, person.get(i).qnt);

        for (int i = 0; i < capsule.size(); ++i)
            flow.addEdge(i * 2 + 2, SNK, capsule.get(i).qnt);

        spread_venom(bad.x, bad.y, T, N);

        for (int i = 0; i < person.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < capsule.size(); ++j) {
                int t = travel_time(person.get(i), capsule.get(j), N, T);
                if (t <= T) flow.addEdge(i * 2 + 1, j * 2 + 2, 999);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.maxFlow(S, SNK));
        sc.close();
    }
}
